_comment: File sources (#26): every file the downloader lands under s3://<landing>/raw/<source>/ and where it goes. The forwarder copies a source's files into the volume at the same key; ingestion reads each source's prefix with Auto Loader. Onboarding a file source is one entry here. JSON, not YAML: the forwarder Lambda's runtime has no YAML library.

tlc_fhvhv.description: TLC high-volume for-hire trips, one Parquet file a month

noaa_ghcnd.description: NOAA GHCN-Daily, one gzipped CSV a year, every station (Central Park is USW00094728)

payouts_ach.description: The payments processor's weekly NACHA (ACH) payout file, one per week (synthetic, services/payouts)
